title: Compact subspace supports joint eye/image decoding
key_values: selected hard-negative n128 feature posterior, pyramid_local_field k8 cosine with compact k10: zeroed-eye 0.765/0.668/0.576 at 0.5/1/2x; compact-only 0.850/0.838/0.826; compact-removed 0.759/0.635/0.537; full joint and compact-addback 0.872/0.872/0.871; known-eye ceiling 0.927/0.936/0.949
claim: When eye position is latent, compact-only recovery retains much of full joint feature recovery, while compact removal collapses recovery toward the zeroed-eye curve.
claim_boundary: This is an absolute feature-posterior endpoint, not image-identity accuracy or a gain normalized to the moving zero-eye baseline. It supports compact-subspace necessity for this projection intervention, not that the animal computes the posterior, that the compact subspace is unique, or that behavior optimizes this objective.
production_gate: Keep image-identity observer, posterior-Neff, source-contrast, motion-delta diagnostics, and static-PC/non-unique compact controls in caption/supplement.

title: Along-edge motion benefits model feature encoding
key_values: matched-static 0.5x pyramid_local_field k8 feature posterior: along-edge joint-zero gain +6.052 [-MSE], across-edge +3.684, paired along-minus-across +2.368 CI [+0.392,+4.589], p=0.0257. Hard-negative guardrail: n64 feature posterior parallel-minus-orthogonal -0.745 CI [-3.147,+1.631]. Preservation support remains: pixel advantage 300.54 CI [172.789,408.961], twin advantage 0.000454497 CI [0.000371047,0.000536519].
claim: In the scoped matched-static hidden-eye feature-posterior observer, along-edge trajectory priors recover more local feature signal than matched across-edge priors.
claim_boundary: This is a model-scoped feature-recovery result. The hard-negative branch limits the axis claim, and preservation is supporting mechanism evidence rather than proof of behavioral optimization or a universal edge-parallel policy.
production_gate: Keep hard-negative axis-preference, edge-preservation, raw-edge objective guardrails, and axis-estimator sensitivity visible in caption/supplement; do not promote a universal parallel-policy claim unless objective-landscape and raw-edge residual gates pass.
